entries.78fe053b2d08396a: This is a business that develops, manufactures and sells Western-style confectionery at the 5 stores of the confectionery shop "Atelier Ukai". It has stores at Torie Keio Chofu, which has an attached confectionery workshop, as well as at Ekyuto Shinagawa, Takashimaya Kyoto and Takashimaya Osaka, and GranSta Tokyo, and also carries out EC sales and event stores at department stores. Sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥1,994 million.
entries.7c1733a0b6c81f8c: Ukai Toriyama was founded in Hachioji, Tokyo, in 1964, and the company was established in 1968 as Ukai Toriyama Co., Ltd. It does not prepare consolidated financial statements, and is listed on the Standard Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange. The number of employees as of March 31, 2026 was 589.

entries.8baf1f7cd7840b0a: For the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue rose 0.8% year on year to ¥13,570 million, and net income was ¥295 million. It has been restructuring its business portfolio by transferring the Cultural Business to the successor in October 2025, and both the Restaurant Division and the Merchandise Division recorded higher revenue.

entries.a0b33fbf5939317d: As its corporate philosophy, it has set the basic principle “Profit lies in the shadow of people’s joy” and the store principle “Creating stores that last 100 years.” Its Long-Term Management Vision 2035 sets as its target image “Engaging in diverse food businesses, building enduring companies and brands, and producing smiles, emotion and happy moments for everyone,” and sets as key measures “Improving earnings capacity” and “Strengthening human capital and enhancing frontline environments.” Under the Medium-Term Management Plan 2030, it positions the creation of new businesses by its subsidiary UKAIzm corporation, established in April 2025, and the merchandise sales business as pillars of growth.

entries.fbbdeebd82697824: A business operating dinner restaurants: five Japanese restaurants and eight Western-style restaurants. For Japanese cuisine, it operates “Ukai Toriyama” (irori charcoal-grilled cuisine), “Tofuya Ukai” (tofu cuisine) and “kappou ukai” (kaiseki cuisine); for Western cuisine, it operates “Ukai-tei” (teppan-grilled cuisine) and others. Sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥11,022 million.
entries.fbfb3938e73898d7: Its stores are characterized by providing an experience that includes the space and the service, such as "Ukai Toriyama," a large restaurant with a garden serving irori charcoal-grilled dishes, and "Ukai-tei," which serves teppanyaki cooked in front of guests.
